'''Cleanse''' ({{G|Cleanse}}) is an [[Set bonus|intrinsic]] that removes harmful status effects. On [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo armor]] it works constantly, making the wearer immune to certain effects, and on a few [[food]]s it removes them once when eaten.

The developer describes shakudo as the alloy that "cleanses malefic".<ref>{{Cite video|quote=Shikudo, a gold-copper alloy that cleanses malefic, steals life from mobs, and whose tools have silk touch as an intrinsic.}}</ref>

== Equipment ==
Each shakudo armor piece cleanses a different set of effects. The effect is removed every tick, so while the piece is worn the effect can never take hold.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/cleanse_armor_chest.json}}</ref>
{| class="wikitable"
! Item !! Tooltip !! Effects removed
|-
| {{ItemLink|Shakudo Helmet}} || {{G|Cleanse}} Cleanses: Blindness, Darkness || {{MCW|Blindness}}, {{MCW|Darkness}}<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/cleanse_armor_head.mcfunction}}</ref>
|-
| {{ItemLink|Shakudo Chestplate}} || {{G|Cleanse}} Cleanses: Poison || {{MCW|Poison}}<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/cleanse_armor_chest.mcfunction}}</ref>
|-
| {{ItemLink|Shakudo Leggings}} || {{G|Cleanse}} Cleanses: Slowness || {{MCW|Slowness}}<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/cleanse_armor_legs.mcfunction}}</ref>
|-
| {{ItemLink|Shakudo Boots}} || {{G|Cleanse}} Cleanses: Levitation || {{MCW|Levitation}}<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/cleanse_armor_feet.mcfunction}}</ref>
|-
| {{ItemLink|Shakudo Elytra}} || {{G|Cleanse}} Cleanse Maleffect || Poison, [[Wither effect|Wither]], Mining Fatigue, Weakness, Blindness, Darkness, Infested, Weaving, Nausea, Oozing and Slowness<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/cleanse_armor_maleffect.mcfunction}}</ref>
|}
The shakudo elytra is the only equipment that cleanses the [[Wither effect]], which is especially dangerous in [[Hell]].

== Food ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Food !! Tooltip !! Effects removed when eaten
|-
| {{ItemLink|Bread}}, {{ItemLink|Honey Ginger Tea}}, {{ItemLink|Ice Cream}} || {{G|Cleanse}} Cleanse Maleffect || Poison, Mining Fatigue, Wither, Weakness, Bad Omen, Blindness, Darkness, Infested, Weaving, Nausea, Oozing and Slowness
|-
| {{ItemLink|Milk Bottle}} || {{G|Cleanse}} Cleanse || All effects, good and bad
|}
Food cleansing is a one-time removal, not an immunity. The food version of Cleanse Maleffect also removes {{MCW|Bad Omen}}, which the shakudo elytra does not.
